form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: How values in this column are formatted: General, Number, Date Time or Text. Number and Date Time show further options.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: General, Number, Date Time or Text.

form:FormGroup.label: Decimal Places
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of decimal places to show, from 0 to 10.

form:FormGroup.label: Format
form:FormGroup.helpText: Date and time format to use, chosen from a list of standard formats. Ignored when Use Preferences is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Ignored when Use Preferences is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Custom Format
form:FormGroup.helpText: Your own date and time pattern, e.g. dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm. Used only when Custom is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Pattern, e.g. dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm. Used when Custom is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Zone
form:FormGroup.helpText: Time zone used to show dates when Use Preferences is not ticked: Local (your browser's time zone), UTC, Id (a named zone) or Offset (a fixed offset from UTC). Default is UTC.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Local, UTC, Id or Offset. Used when Use Preferences is not ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Zone Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Named time zone to use, e.g. Europe/London.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Zone Offset
form:FormGroup.helpText: Fixed offset from UTC, as hours (-12 to +12) and minutes (0 to 59).
